liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The interpolator of William of Malmesbury’s Gesta regum
liebermann.notes: A copyist of c. 1150–1200 who inserted from Quadripartitus Wl lad and the Praefatio to CHn cor after the history of William I in William of Malmesbury's Gesta Regum; copied in Cs, Ht, He and Pi.
